inputs.prompt: Keep everything in image 1 exactly as it is: the same room, the same camera position and framing, the same night light, the man asleep in the bed, who has not moved, and the man made of mint light standing between the foot of the bed and the desk, in the same place and pose. Change two things: the man of light is now fully formed down to his bare feet, standing on the floorboards, and the ribbon of light from the phone has almost faded away, leaving only a few last glowing particles drifting near the phone. He is an exact copy of the man shown in image 2 and image 3, who is also the man in the bed: the same face, the same short dark hair and trimmed beard, the same warm medium-brown skin, the same dark charcoal T-shirt and the same loose dark grey pyjama trousers. His face and skin keep their own natural brown colour and his clothes keep their own dark colours; only the light is pale mint-green (#b7f4cf). He glows softly from within and is slightly see-through, with soft edges and no drawn outline. He looks toward the desk with a calm, awake, friendly face, lips closed. It must read as friendly, advanced technology, never as a ghost or a spirit: no mist, no smoke, no dark shadows, nothing spooky. There are exactly two people in the room: one solid and asleep in the bed, one made of light. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film. Nothing written anywhere.

expect.unit: USD (the endpoint bills in units of 1 dollar, by tokens)
expect.basis: WP1 and WP3 paid 6 to 9 cents for a 2K picture on this model (demo-video/ledger/wp3.csv)

note: Motion test A, last key frame: the man of light fully formed, the ribbon from the phone fading
